Personal Guarantee Agreement
I, Kambuljon Kazakov (Full name of Guarantor) herein referred to as “Guarantor” absolutely
and unconditionally guarantees all obligations of Xpress Global Transport LLC to Club
Organizer pursuant to the Fuel Savings Club Agreement. The death or incompetence of the

Guarantor shall not revoke this Guaranty. The. parties hereby knowingly, voluntarily, and
intentionally waive the right either may have to a trial by jury in respect of any litigation based
hereon, or arising out of, under or in connection with this Agreement and any agreement
contemplated to be executed in conjunction herewith, or any course of conduct, course of
dealing, statements (whether verbal or written) or action of either party. This provision is a
material inducement for Club Organizer entering into this transaction with M ember. This
Guaranty cannot be revoked. Without this Guaranty, Club Organizer would be unwilling to make
the Fuel Savings Club Agreement with the Club M ember.
 
Guarantor executes this agreement in his or her individual capacity with the intent to be
personally liable for the obligations described herein.
I. THE PARTIES
This Fuel Savings Club Agreement (the “Agreement”) is being made on 12/20/2023 between
 Cube System (the “Club Organizer”) and Xpress Global Transport LLC (Name of M ember).
II. THE PARTIES’ INTENT
Club M ember is a professional commercial driver or a business engaged in transportation
and/or logistics services that desire to save money on fuel. Club Organizer is a company that
negotiates fuel discounts for its members with various fueling stations/outlets for a fee. It is
the intent of the Parties to this Agreement to enter a relationship wherein both Parties will
benefit financially from fuel purchase transactions.  
III. SERVICES PROVIDED BY THE CLUB ORGANIZER
1. Club Organizer will negotiate fuel prices at a discounted rate on behalf of its members
providing savings on fuel to Club M embers ranging from $0.20 to $0.70 per gallon.
2. The fuel discount rate is variable and subject to change daily.
3. Club Organizer cannot provide a guarantee of any specific discount rate.
4. Club Organizer will provide Club M ember with a list of participating fueling
stations/outlets where Club M ember can obtain a discounted rate on fuel.
5. Club Organizer will provide Club M ember with a Fuel Discount Club Card to use at the
designated participating fueling stations/outlets.
6. Club Organizer will invoice Club M embers twice per week (ex. Each M onday and
Thursday) 
IV. CLUB M EM BER’S DUTIES
1. To obtain a discounted rate, Club M ember must charge the fuel purchase to the Fuel
Discount Club Card issued to Club M ember by Club Organizer at participating fueling
stations/outlets designated by Club Organizer.
2. Club M ember agrees to pay each invoice within 24 hours of receipt.
3. Club M ember has the following options to pay invoices:
1. Set up automatic payment allowing Club Organizer to charge Club M ember the full
amount of the invoice, each invoice period; or
2. Pay manually each invoice period.
4. If Club M ember does not pay each invoice in full within 24 hours of receipt, an annual
interest rate of 29.99% will apply to any unpaid balance.
5. In case if client does not pay within 24 hours after receiving the invoice, they are agreed
to pay 1.9% interest rate fee to Cube Systems LLC

     6. Club Organizer reserves the right to stop providing Fuel Discount Club Card services if
Club M ember does not pay invoices in full within 24 hours of receipt.
 
 
V. AGREEM ENT NON-TRANSFERRABLE AND NON-ASSIGNABLE
1. The Fuel Discount Club Card is not transferrable and may only be used by Club M embers.
Club M ember is strictly responsible for safekeeping the card and preventing theft. Club
M embers must notify Club Organizer immediately if the card is lost or stolen.
2. Club M ember may not assign any rights or obligations under this Agreement to any other
party. 
VI.NOTICE BY ELECTRONIC M EANS
1. Club M ember agrees to receive all notices, requests, demands, and other
communications regarding this Agreement by electronic means only to the email
designated by Club M ember in Club M ember’s application.
2. Club M ember waives any right to receive paper notices, requests, demands, and other
communications by mail.
3. Club M ember must notify Club Organizer immediately of any change to Club M ember’s
email address.
VII. PRIVACY POLICY
1. Club Organizer will not use any data collected from Club M ember in relation to this
Agreement for any purpose other than to provide services and enforce the terms of this
Agreement.
2. Club Organizer will take all reasonable steps to protect all confidential information
provided by Club M ember in the course of the Parties’ relationship pursuant to this
Agreement.
3. Club Organizer certifies that it will not sell any data provided by Club M ember in relation
to this Agreement to any third party.
VIII. DISPUTES
1. This Agreement will be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the
State of Florida. The Parties agree that the venue to enforce this Agreement is Orange
County, Florida.
2. The prevailing party to any dispute arising under this Agreement is entitled to reasonable
attorney’s fees and costs from the losing party.
3. In the event that Club M ember does not pay in full Club M ember’s outstanding balance
and Club Organizer engages the services of the debt collection agency to enforce this
Agreement, the cost of such services shall be due to Club Organizer by Club M ember.
4. If a Club M ember fails to pay their invoice within 72 hours of receipt, the Club Organizer
reserves the right to deactivate the M ember's cards until full payment is received. If the
M ember fails to pay their invoice within 10 days of receipt, the Club Organizer may report
the outstanding debt to a collections agency.
5. If a Club M ember incurs a debt to the Club Organizer, the Club Organizer reserves the
right to suspend or revoke any and all discounts and privileges associated with Club
M embership. In such cases, the discounted amount will not be deducted from the Club
M ember's invoice.
